title: h3spec HTTP/3 Server Conformance Pipeline Verification
verification_method: Build, requirement-home tests, plan-only h3spec runner execution, parser smoke test, and SpecTrace validation.
scope: Verify that the repository exposes an advisory h3spec HTTP/3 server conformance pipeline that captures raw output, normalizes results, maps RFC 9114/RFC 9204 failures, and keeps failures as TODO/triage evidence until protocol-owned requirements close them.
expected_result: The build and requirement-home tests pass, the plan-only runner emits raw-log placeholders and parsed report artifacts, the parser maps sample HTTP/3 and QPACK failures to RFC 9114 and RFC 9204 TODO rows, and SpecTrace validation accepts the new artifacts.
evidence: 2026-05-25: `dotnet build Incursa.Quic.slnx -c Release --no-restore` passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors.

2026-05-25: parser smoke under `.artifacts/http3-h3spec-parser-smoke` mapped sample h3spec failures to `RFC 9114 Section 4.1` / `http3-adapter-boundary` and `RFC 9204 Section 3.1` / `qpack-stream-state-boundary` TODO rows.
status_summary: Passed for the advisory h3spec harness, parser, report, and CI-dispatch surfaces. The preserved plan-only evidence proves artifact generation only; live h3spec conformance remains opt-in and failures must be promoted into protocol-owned RFC 9114 or RFC 9204 work before support claims change.
